Source-bit registries for source_mask

Source: R/md-compact.R
md_name_sources.Rd

A bitmask computed fresh per compaction run is a hazard: add a source mid-project and every existing bit shifts. These are frozen registries, in the same spirit as md_layers() (PLAN.md section 3a) — a new source appends a new bit; nothing already assigned ever moves.

Usage

md_name_sources()

md_address_sources()

Value

A named integer vector, source name to bit value.
